exposure: breech delivery of the second twin
vaginal delivery of the first twin
outcome: Composite adverse neonatal outcome (perinatal death, admission to NICU, endotracheal intubation, Apgar <7 at five minutes, and cord lactate >4.0 mmol/L)
cohort: Twin pregnancies with a vaginal delivery of the first twin
finding: The inter-twin delivery interval is associated with higher rates of low Apgar scores and higher cord lactate for the second twin.
mod_finding: Cesarean section for the second twin was more frequent with inter-twin delivery intervals >30 minutes.
